summary:
On 2026-10-30 the owner chose "Full cutover now", explicitly overriding the standing rule that Home runs only fdev-admitted scripts, for this migration only. Home performed it and reports it here and on #4516; fdev (Programme/root) did not admit it beforehand. Original failures, holds and Unknowns are not resolved by the move.

Moved (host instance stopped and disabled, its data retained untouched on Home as rollback):
- fsgg-store receiver: same image and state, now account fsgg-store-dev (uid 30033, subuids 362144+65536, identical to Home) inside fdev, Quadlet `fsgg-store.service`, Supervisor `telemetry-home` running. Published 192.168.1.129:8447 (HTTPS, certificate CN fsgg-store.lan unchanged) and :2227 (SSH) via the VMM container. Inside fdev `fsgg-store.lan` resolves to 127.0.0.1. Its authorized_keys were emptied on 2026-10-30 (both keys had no known holder; backup kept beside the file).
- LEARN qualification: account fsgg-learn-qual (uid 30034, subuids 427680+131072) and its account home copied to the identical path under /mnt/storage (bulk disk); the 160 GiB qualification.img is attached as virtio disk `fdev-learn-qual` and mounted at the original path; container `learn-qualification` running, SSH published 192.168.1.129:2228. Operator scripts are bind-mounted read-only at /usr/local/libexec/fsgg-learn. Home's hash-pinned sudoers rule was retired.
- v3-storage: the 2 TiB pool.img is attached as `fdev-v3-pool` (label systemadmin-v3) and mounted at /srv/v3-pool; the provisioner (patched to accept the attached device, filesystem UUID still checked) and its reconcile timer run as fdev's developer; host state (leases) copied; five old leases name Home's former UDisks mount path.
- SC2 reserved storage op e995b57e: see environment/sc2-reserved-storage-in-fdev.
- Telemetry producer `fsharp-dev-main` (config, spool, fs-gg-private work state) now lives in fdev; the fsharp-dev client was retired by renaming its configuration. Endpoint unchanged (telemetry.main.internal:8443, no listener since before the move).
- Home timers for the telemetry drain and Coordination CLI update are disabled; fdev user timers replace them. Home's automatic Codex wake from #4516/#4517 comments is disabled; mail reading continues.

Identity: Home attaches each disk image by path and refuses to start fdev if its device/inode changed. The images stay physically on Home's HDD with their owners; Home granted its VMM user rw ACLs.
Qualification-VM provider: still source only; fdev (root + nested KVM) is now its natural host; nothing was installed.

Verified by Home after a cold fdev restart: both services active, all mounts present, receiver HTTPS answering via Home's LAN address. Not verified: application-level qualification, ingestion, LEARN operations, v3 pilot launches.
title: Home subsystems moved into fdev on 2026-10-30: fsgg-store, LEARN, v3-storage, SC2, telemetry client, timers
